item.title: Singleplayer Installation Guide
item.description: The installation guide for downloading Myriad for your Minecraft: Java Edition singleplayer world.
This version rebrands the pack to Myriad, adds new models for baby snails and sproutlings, and ports to Tiny Takeover.

item.title: The Rebrand
item.description: Learn all about why The Creeper’s Code was renamed to Myriad.
This version ports to the mounts of mayhem drop, while adding a few minor features in the process.

item.title: 1.6.0: Resin and Ruins
item.description: This update adds the creaking crypt, resin pottery, resin candy, as well as reworking the woodland mansion, ancient city archaeology, and much more.

item.title: A Clean Slate
item.description: Discover why everything got rebuilt from the ground up for 1.13.

item.title: The Beginning
item.description: How it all began.

item.title: Accessible Music Discs
item.description: Several music discs are now more accessible or made renewable.

item.title: Amethyst Dust
item.description: The powdered version of amethyst shards, used as an ingredient.

item.title: Ancient City Archaeology
item.description: Ancient cities now have several archaeology sites filled with loot and secrets.

item.title: Apple Pie
item.description: A tasty new food item, and the apple equivalent to pumpkin pie.

item.title: Archaeologist
item.description: A new villager type that trades archaeology-related items.

item.title: Armor Stands with Arms
item.description: The same armor stand you know, now with arms and poses. Just add two sticks!

item.title: Armor Trim Addon
item.description: The installation guide for using the armor trim addon, as well as a guide to finding all the new armor trims included.

item.title: Axolotl Bucket Variants
item.description: Axolotl buckets now display their variants, instead of having a pink axolotl for all textures. Babies are also displayed!

item.title: Badlands Temple
item.description: The badlands temple is a dangerous structure with traps and loot galore.

item.title: Bat Wing
item.description: A new ingredient dropped by bat wings that can be crafted into leather.

item.title: Better Mangrove Roots
item.description: Mangrove roots are now less of a hassle to deal with, only dropping themselves when mined with silk touch or shears.

item.title: Biome Based Fishing
item.description: Rarities of fish are now different depending on which biome you are fishing in.

item.title: Boomerang
item.description: A fun weapon and even more fun farming tool. Harvest & replant crops, kill your enemies, or just use it as a fidget toy.

item.title: Brush Painting
item.description: Brushes can now be used with dye in the other hand to change the color of blocks using the brush’s durability.

item.title: Cake Improvements
item.description: Cakes can now be mined and moved without silk touch.

item.title: Campfire Improvements
item.description: Campfires now have an unlit variant that drops when mining them with an axe without silk touch.

item.title: Cat Improvements
item.description: Cats now have more loot in their morning gift pool, and can be tamed using tropical fish.

item.title: Cherry Grove Village
item.description: A cherry grove variant of villages. Very pretty, very pink.

item.title: Climbable Chains
item.description: Chains can now be climbed like ladders.

item.title: Consistent Dye Recipes
item.description: Several dye recipes are now more consistent.

item.title: Consistent Loom Recipe
item.description: The loom recipe is now more consistent with other workstations’ recipes.

item.title: Consistent Rib Armor Trim Duplication
item.description: Rib armor trim templates are now duplicated with nether bricks instead of netherrack.

item.title: Consistent Stair Recipe Yield
item.description: All stair recipes now give an output of 6 instead of 4.

item.title: Consistent Trapdoor Recipe Yield
item.description: Trapdoor recipes now give equivalent amounts when compared to door recipes.

item.title: Coral Drowned
item.description: A new cosmetic variant of drowned that drops coral, making it more accessible early-game.

item.title: Coral Recipes
item.description: Coral blocks are now craftable from coral and coral fans in a 2x2.

item.title: Cracked Deepslate Tile Recipes
item.description: Cracked deepslate tiles can now be crafted from cracked deepslate bricks.

item.title: Craftable Mushroom Blocks
item.description: Mushroom blocks are now craftable using 4 mushrooms.

item.title: Craftable Nautilus Armor
item.description: Nautilus armor is now craftable using 8 of an armor material and a nautilus shell.

item.title: Craftable Snout Banner Pattern
item.description: The snout banner pattern can now be crafted with a piglin head and a piece of paper.

item.title: Crashed End Ship
item.description: A spooky, abandoned end structure found rarely in the outer end islands.

item.title: Creaking Connector
item.description: A new redstone component that allows transfer of signals over long distances.

item.title: Creaking Crypt
item.description: A new pale garden structure filled with archaeology, loot, and plenty of creaking.

item.title: Crescent Banner Pattern
item.description: A moon-shaped banner pattern found in the creaking crypt.

item.title: Cursed Crown
item.description: A unique armor item that replaces your health with regenerating absorption hearts.

item.title: Dead Bush Recipes
item.description: Dead bushes can now be crafted using both types of bushes in furnaces.

item.title: Desert Well Rework
item.description: The desert well now has slightly better archaeology loot and two layers of suspicious sand.

item.title: Diluted Potions
item.description: A potion type you can take your time sipping. One full duration of potion spread over multiple uses.

item.title: Dragon Head Renewability
item.description: The ender dragon now drops its head when killed by a charged creeper.

item.title: Dry Grass Beetroot Seeds
item.description: Dry grass now has a chance to drop beetroot seeds.

item.title: Dyed Compasses
item.description: Compasses can now be dyed all 16 colors. Perfect for keeping track of multiple different lodestones.

item.title: Dyed Written Books
item.description: Written books can now be dyed all 16 colors.

item.title: Echo Shard Renewability
item.description: Echo shards are now renewable using a dangerous interaction between sculk shriekers and amethyst clusters.

item.title: Echoing Hourglass
item.description: A magical block that allows its user to sift through the sands of time to renew archaeology loot.

item.title: Elder Guardian Improvements
item.description: Elder guardians have been slightly improved to have more consistent mining fatigue behavior. Guardians struck by lightning also turn into elder guardians.

item.title: Emoji
item.description: A way to express all your villager-based emotions in chat with a handy menu that lets you choose which emoji to send.

item.title: Enchanted Golden Carrot
item.description: The rare loot-exclusive variant of the golden carrot that gives night vision for 40 minutes.

item.title: Enchanter
item.description: The support class of illagers that call the woodland mansion rework their home.

item.title: End City Loot Improvements
item.description: End city loot has been reworked to be slightly more tolerable.

item.title: Fishing Treasure Particles
item.description: Bubble popping particles now show up in areas where fishing will yield no treasure.

item.title: Frequently Asked Questions
item.description: All your burning questions answered in one convenient place.

item.title: Frostbloom
item.description: A unique flower that creates an aura of snow around it.

item.title: Frostbloom Petals
item.description: A frosty floral treat that grant regeneration at the cost of mobility.

item.title: Fungal Stew
item.description: A nether equivalent to mushroom stew, crafted with warped and crimson fungi.

item.title: Geomancer
item.description: A crotchety old illager that lives deep down in the deepslate layer of the world. Watch out for his explosive pillars.

item.title: Gilded Blackstone Rework
item.description: Gilded blackstone now functions more like an ore.

item.title: Glazed Terracotta Pots
item.description: A handy set of decoration blocks made from glazed terracotta. Store your items in style!

item.title: Glow Berry Muffin
item.description: A sweet treat made from glow berries. More filling than normal glow berries and quite a bit more convenient.

item.title: Glow Lichen Zombie
item.description: A blind, lichen-covered zombie variant found in the deepslate layer of the world.

item.title: Gobblerift
item.description: A strange plant native to the End. Drinking its riftjuice allows for long-distance teleportation.

item.title: Golden Apple Pie
item.description: A new pastry variation on golden apples, converting their healing effect into haste and speed instead.

item.title: Golden Chorus Fruit
item.description: Chorus fruit, but much much more effective. Throw yourself to the far reaches of your world with a single bite.

item.title: Grouped Glazed Terracotta Recipes
item.description: Glazed terracotta recipes are now grouped in the furnace recipe book.

item.title: Hay Vibration Dampening
item.description: Hay blocks can now be used to dampen sculk sensor vibrations in addition to wool.

item.title: Heartbeet
item.description: A healing variant of beetroot that rarely drops from beetroot crops. They can be used in health boost potions.

item.title: Hoglin Improvements
item.description: Hoglins now have 2-3 babies when breeding instead of just one.

item.title: Horse Armor Improvements
item.description: Horse armor is now craftable and enchantable. It has also been removed from many loot tables to reduce inventory clutter.

item.title: How to Beta Test
item.description: Want to test new content? Find out how here!

item.title: Iceologer
item.description: A dangerous ice wizard that summons blocks of falling ice. Can be found chilling out in tundra keeps.

item.title: Improved Prismarine Recipes
item.description: Prismarine recipes are now more consistent with other recipes in the game.

item.title: Improved Trident Enchantments
item.description: The impaling and loyalty trident enchantments have several improvements to make them more usable.

item.title: Increased Chain Yield
item.description: Chain recipes now give 4 chains instead of 1.

item.title: Increased Emerald Ore Drops
item.description: Emerald ore now drops 1-4 emeralds to make emerald ore more useful when compared to getting all your emeralds from villagers.

item.title: Increased Shulker Drops
item.description: Shulkers now drop 1-2 shulker shells instead of 0-1. With looting III, they will always drop two shells.

item.title: Increased TNT Yield
item.description: The TNT recipe now yields four TNT instead of just one. Makes it more viable to craft TNT instead of using TNT dupers.

item.title: Jungle Temple Rework
item.description: The jungle temple has been reworked to include better traps, loot, and puzzles. It also has an archaeology section and exclusive sherds as well.

item.title: Learning Enchantment
item.description: A sword & spear enchantment that increases experience drops from mobs, at the cost of being incompatible with looting.

item.title: Locket of Learning
item.description: A helpful enchanting tool that allows you to store up to thirty levels of experience points. It is also the main reward of the reworked woodland mansion.

item.title: Mace Renewability
item.description: Maces are now renewable via the rare chance of zombies and husks spawning holding them during ominous trials.

item.title: Mangrove Swamp Village
item.description: A new village variant found in the mangrove swamp. A rare find, hidden deep between mangrove roots.

item.title: More Copper Smeltables
item.description: More items can be smelted down into copper nuggets, including spyglasses, brushes, and trial keys.

item.title: More Flower Pots
item.description: Flower pots can now be made using prismarine sherds, resin bricks, or nether bricks.

item.title: More Illager Banners
item.description: More illager banners (similar to the ominous banner) can be found in all of Myriad’s new illager structures.

item.title: More Mineable Blocks
item.description: More blocks now have proper tools that allow them to be mined faster.

item.title: More Mossy Recipes
item.description: Mossy blocks can now be crafted more efficiently using a single moss block and the block you want to mossify.

item.title: More Potted Plants
item.description: More plants can now be placed in flower pots, including two-block-tall flowers, different kinds of grass, and unique Myriad plants.

item.title: More Sniffer Loot
item.description: Sniffers now dig up more ancient seeds at a time, and can also dig up frostblooms.

item.title: More Stone Substitutions
item.description: Deepslate and blackstone can now be used as substitutes for stone in more recipes.

item.title: More Suspicious Stews
item.description: Suspicious stews can now be made with more flowers, including chorus flowers, flowering azaleas, cactus flowers, pink petals, and wildflowers.

item.title: More Undead Nugget Drops
item.description: Zombies, husks, and drowned now drop nuggets similarly to zombified piglins. A cheap, consistent income of metal and a better drop than rotten flesh.

item.title: Multiplayer Installation Guide
item.description: The installation guide for downloading Myriad for your Minecraft: Java Edition multiplayer server.

item.title: Nether Brick Pottery
item.description: A nether-based style of pottery made from nether bricks, including 18 new sherd variants found all over various structures.

item.title: Nether Gold Ore Vein
item.description: The nether equivalent to iron or copper ore veins. A giant gold vein found rarely in basalt deltas, composed of gilded blackstone.

item.title: Nether Reactor
item.description: A feature resurrected from ancient versions of pocket edition, but given a whole new purpose. Spend a nether star on a nether reactor core and build its casing to create an area of fire resistance.

item.title: Ocean Monument Rework
item.description: The ocean monument has been reworked to bring it up to modern structure standards. More loot, more depth, and a better build.

item.title: Ocean Ruin Archaeology Rework
item.description: Ocean ruins now have better archaeology, including a mysterious new mob egg and several new prismarine sherds.

item.title: Paintbrush
item.description: A building tool used to paint blocks using dye.

item.title: Phantom Item Frame
item.description: A unique take on invisible item frames, made from phantom membranes. Put an item in and watch the back frame disappear.

item.title: Pig Improvements
item.description: Pigs now have 2-3 babies at once instead of just one, making them more effective competitors against cows or sheep.

item.title: Piglin Bartering Archaeology
item.description: Piglins can now rarely barter suspicious gravel with loot inside instead of normal gravel.

item.title: Potion of Blind Rage
item.description: A risky potion that allows you to deal a massive amount of damage with the drawback of being fully blind.

item.title: Potion of Fortitude
item.description: A health boost potion, brewed from heartbeets.

item.title: Pottery Table
item.description: A block used to decoration pots and duplicate sherds. It’s also the workstation for the new archaeologist villager.

item.title: Prismarine Pottery
item.description: An ocean-based style of pottery made from prismarine, including 10 sherd patterns found in ocean ruins.

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.description: What we do with your data.

item.title: Quarry Remnant
item.description: A long-forgotten mine found deep underneath the basalt deltas.

item.title: Ravager Sentry Armor Trim Drop
item.description: Ravagers now drop the sentry armor trim rarely, instead of just a saddle.

item.title: Reactive Seeker
item.description: A unique tracking device made from netherite that points to a mysterious nether structure…

item.title: Recovery Compass Rework
item.description: Recovery compasses are now cheaper and make the items from your last death glow while held in your hand.

item.title: Refuge Remains
item.description: The nether counterpart to the trail ruins, including plenty of loot and nether brick pottery sherds.

item.title: Resin Brick Pottery
item.description: A resin-based style of pottery, including 8 new sherd patterns found in various structures.

item.title: Resin Candy
item.description: A sweet treat made from resin clumps and sugar. It awakens at night, becoming more filling when eaten.

item.title: Riftjuice Bottle
item.description: The liquid product of the gobblerift, used to teleport back to the gobblerift it was harvested from.

item.title: Root Dye Recipes
item.description: Warped, crimson, and hanging roots can all be smelted down into dyes.

item.title: Rooted Dirt Recipe
item.description: Rooted dirt can now be crafted using dirt and hanging roots.

item.title: Rotten Porkchop
item.description: A food item dropped by zombified piglins and zoglins, replacing their food drop. It gives the nausea effect when eaten unless cooked first.

item.title: Scalesprouts
item.description: A unique brewing ingredient sheared from sprouters. It can be used to grow and shrink yourself.

item.title: Sculk Recipe
item.description: Sculk veins can now be crafted into sculk blocks.

item.title: Sightless Eye
item.description: A rare potion ingredient dropped by glow lichen zombies and used to brew potions of blind rage.

item.title: Silk Touch Improvements
item.description: Silk touch now picks up grass paths, filled composters, infested blocks, and charged respawn anchors.

item.title: Smoldering Seeker
item.description: A new compass variant made from nether bricks that points to the nearest nether fortress.

item.title: Snail
item.description: A slimy passive mob found in swamps. When fed beetroot, it spreads slime for 20 minutes.

item.title: Soul Conductor
item.description: A powerful transport block that allows you to travel across lines of sculk blocks instantly. It is crafted using echo shards.

item.title: Soul Seer
item.description: A useful redstone component that gives all mobs in a radius glowing depending on the block placed beneath it.

item.title: Sparse Jungle Village
item.description: A village variant that spawns in the more open areas of the jungle, built surrounding a small central ruin.

item.title: Sprouter
item.description: The long-lost cousin of the sniffer, sprouting flowers that allow you to grow and shrink yourself.

item.title: Sweet Berry Muffin
item.description: A tasty pastry made from sweet berries. More filling and even more convenient than raw sweet berries.

item.title: Swordfish
item.description: Is it a food? Is it a weapon? Who knows!

item.title: Tangling Pearl
item.description: A useful tool crafted from twisting vines that teleports items to you when enabled.

item.title: The Dark Times
item.description: The versions made eons ago with no regard for any sort of design principles.

item.title: Totem Improvements
item.description: Totems can now save you from the void and drowning.

item.title: Trial Chamber Archaeology
item.description: Trial chambers now have small archaeology sections at dead ends instead of cobbled deepslate.

item.title: Tundra Keep
item.description: A snowy illager fort inhabited by iceologers and pillagers.

item.title: Turtle Shell Improvements
item.description: Turtle shells now give more water breathing when equipped.

item.title: Wandering Trader Rework
item.description: Wandering traders’ trades have been completely reworked to be more consistent and worthwhile.

item.title: Wandering Witch
item.description: The nocturnal cousin of the wandering trader. She trades potion-related items and uses spider eyes as currency.

item.title: Waxed Note Blocks
item.description: Note blocks can now be waxed to prevent accidental changes to already set notes.

item.title: Weeping Eye
item.description: A strange item that stares in the direction of the nearest end city. Quite weird to look at, but very useful.

item.title: Witch Hat
item.description: A stylish helmet item that increases drop chances and amounts of various potion ingredients.

item.title: Woodland Mansion Rework
item.description: The woodland mansion has been fully reworked to include new loot, new rooms, and even more enemies.

item.title: Wrench
item.description: A helpful building tool that can rotate blocks.

item.title: Zombie Villager Emerald Drop
item.description: Zombie villagers now rarely drop emeralds instead of iron ingots.
